scope: Cantilune generic four-projection core plus one substantive reference execution; eight production packages are excluded and require separate Product Conformance certificates

statusPolicy.missing: The required central declaration is absent.
statusPolicy.partial_scaffold: A kernel-buildable declaration exists but does not meet the recorded central scope.
statusPolicy.implemented_unverified: The required declaration exists in the working tree but immutable commit-bound build evidence is not yet attached.
statusPolicy.proved: The exact declaration and proof-sensitive tree were checked by the pinned Lean kernel at verifiedCommit; this delivery remains review-pending.
statusPolicy.reviewed: Reserved for a later independently authenticated human QA-L4 gate; the current local gate rejects this status.

commitSemantics.sourceCommit: The immutable proof-sensitive source commit used by every verifiedCommit.
commitSemantics.evidenceCommit: A later single-parent commit that introduces the hashed build-evidence file; it is a strict ancestor and never self-references the final pointer commit.
commitSemantics.pointerCommit: The current HEAD that records proved/review-pending statuses and the two ancestor hashes; its hash is reported externally rather than self-embedded.

evidenceRule: Only the three-commit source/evidence/pointer chain, a pinned clean build, exact tracked-blob checks before and after the build, placeholder scan, source-integrity check, and kernel axiom allowlist audit may promote an obligation to proved. Human review is a separate unavailable gate.
